title: Nonnegativity of a duplicated Gowers inner product
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $F$ assign a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to each point of the $k$-dimensional Boolean cube, and choose a coordinate $i$ and a bit $b\in\mathbb F_2$. Replace the input to $F$ by the point obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $b$. The resulting Gowers inner product, formed by averaging over $y\in(F_2^n)^{k+1}$ and $x\in F_2^n$ the product over all $s\in F_2^{k+1}$ of the family value at $x+\sum_j s_jy_j$, is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real-valued family on the indicated cubes
